High Cholesterol? Do These 3 Step 

#cholesterol #usahealth #chinesemedicineworks #healthybodyhealthymind #usa
transcript: If your cholesterol is high, listen. Chinese medicine lowers it with three simple steps. My friend, in Chinese medicine, we see high cholesterol as a sign that the body circulation has slowed and the digestive fire has weakened. When this happens, the blood becomes heavier and the heart must work harder. To bring the body back into balance, we follow three important steps. Step 1. Warm and support digestion. When the digestive system becomes cold or weak, the body creates dampness and heaviness in the blood. Start your morning warm. Ginger tea, warm meals, fewer ice drinks. This strengthens the spleen and helps clear what the body does not need. Step 2. Relax the liver so blood can flow. Stress and stored emotions tighten the liver. When the liver is tight, fats do not move smoothly. Take a moment each day to relax the body. Slow walking, deep breathing, gentle stretching. When the mind relaxes, circulation improves. Step 3. Strengthen heart circulation. Poor sleep and constant stress weaken heart energy. When circulation slows, cholesterol rises. Support the heart with simple foods known in our tradition. Hawthorne tea, garlic, black fungus, sesame. And give your body consistent rest. My friend, lowering cholesterol is not about fighting the body. It is about helping it return to balance so the blood can flow freely again. If you want deeper guidance and more teachings, my full Chinese Medicine e-book is in the link on my profile.
